dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank exhibit sharp outer perimeters with a distinct dark-to-light gradient moving toward the interior; one prominent 'C' shaped arc is visible posterior to the mid-section with a more diffused gradient edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters localized in the anterior neck and shoulder region; sparse distribution of larger, low-intensity dark voids along the central dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four primary mid-flank annuli form an irregular quadrilateral with the longest axis oriented parallel to the spine.
